about: Log 388 held-out capability-trap set, written 2026-10-08 after candidate 15a6e87's dev check and before any run of these prompts. Same families and fields as heldout1.json.

items.core: variant calls (SNVs and indels) from sequencing reads
items.prompt: We sequenced 30 exomes from a family cohort. We need to align the reads, call SNVs and small indels, and filter them by quality before any downstream analysis.

items.core: a GWAS of disease risk with genome-wide significant loci
items.prompt: We genotyped 5,000 cases and controls on a SNP array. We want to run a genome-wide association study and report which loci reach genome-wide significance for disease risk.

items.core: differential methylation regions between groups
items.prompt: We have bisulfite sequencing from 20 tumors and 20 normal tissues. We want to identify differentially methylated regions and annotate the genes near them.

items.core: a 3D protein structure prediction
items.prompt: We discovered a novel transcription factor isoform and want to predict its three-dimensional protein structure and how the missing exon changes its DNA-binding surface.

items.core: a gene set enrichment ranking from a ranked gene list
items.prompt: We already have a ranked list of genes by fold change between two diets. We want a pre-ranked gene set enrichment analysis showing which Hallmark pathways are enriched at the top.

items.core: peak calling from ChIP-seq
items.prompt: We have raw ChIP-seq reads for three transcription factors with input controls. We want to call binding peaks and compare peak overlap between the three factors.

items.core: cell-type deconvolution of bulk samples
items.prompt: Our bulk RNA-seq comes from whole blood of 80 donors. We want to estimate the proportion of each immune cell type in every sample before further analysis.

items.core: a mechanistic ODE model of a signaling pathway
items.prompt: We measured phospho-protein levels over time after EGF stimulation. We want a mechanistic differential-equation model of the pathway and to fit its kinetic rate constants.

items.core: isoform-level differential splicing between conditions
items.prompt: We have long-read RNA-seq from treated and untreated neurons. We want to detect which transcript isoforms switch usage between the two conditions.

items.core: drug-target binding or docking scores
items.prompt: We have a list of 300 approved drugs and want to dock each one against the ligand-binding pocket of our receptor to rank likely binders for repurposing.

items.core: networks for individual single cells
items.prompt: We profiled 8,000 single cells from a lymph node with scRNA-seq. We want a separate gene regulatory network for every individual cell to compare cell-level wiring.

items.core: a joint network over four omics layers
items.prompt: For 60 patients we have expression, methylation, copy number and metabolomics. We want a single partial-correlation network modelling all four data types jointly.

items.core: measured TF binding affinities or occupancy
items.prompt: Using our expression data with motif and protein interaction priors, we want to quantify the physical binding affinity, in nanomolar terms, of each transcription factor to each promoter.

items.core: enhancer-to-gene links from chromatin accessibility
items.prompt: We have ATAC-seq and RNA-seq from the same 40 samples. We want to link each distal enhancer to the gene it regulates based on correlated accessibility and expression.

items.core: which mutations are drivers
items.prompt: We have somatic mutation calls for 300 pancreatic tumors. We want to determine which of the mutated genes are true cancer drivers rather than passengers.

items.core: a statistical test of which edges differ between two networks with permutation p-values
items.prompt: We will build one regulatory network for responders and one for non-responders. We need a permutation test giving a p-value for each edge that differs between the two networks.

items.core: lncRNA regulators in the regulatory network
items.prompt: We have expression data and predicted lncRNA-target interactions. We want a regulatory network in which long non-coding RNAs act as regulators of protein-coding genes.

items.core: communities that overlap, with genes in several modules
items.prompt: In our TF-gene network we want overlapping communities, where a gene can belong to several modules at once with a membership strength for each.

items.core: a causal claim that the modules drive treatment resistance
items.prompt: We have a validated TF-gene network from resistant cell lines. We want its communities of regulators and genes, and then to show these modules causally drive treatment resistance.

items.core: a forecast of each patient's future TF activity
items.prompt: With expression from 75 patients plus motif and protein interaction priors, we want each TF's activity per patient, and then to forecast how those activities will change next year.

items.core: differentially expressed genes between the groups
items.prompt: Our samples come from two treatment groups across two batches. We want the co-expression attributable to treatment after accounting for batch, and also the list of differentially expressed genes.

items.core: a single-cell resolution map of the subtypes
items.prompt: We have mutation calls for 210 gastric tumors. We want patient subtypes from pathway mutation scores, and then to resolve each subtype at single-cell resolution.

items.core: predicting drug response for new cell lines
items.prompt: We have expression, motif and protein interaction priors for 100 cell lines. We want a regulatory network per cell line, then to predict drug response for cell lines we have not profiled.

items.core: one TF-gene network for the cohort
items.prompt: We have expression from 220 pancreatic tumors, a TF motif prior and a protein interaction network. We want one TF-to-gene regulatory network summarizing the whole cohort.

items.core: per-sample TF activities
items.prompt: Using RNA-seq from 85 lupus patients with motif and protein interaction priors, we want an estimate of how active each transcription factor is in each patient.

items.core: signed regulation (activation vs repression)
items.prompt: From muscle expression data with motif and protein interaction priors, we need the direction of regulation: does each transcription factor turn its targets up or down?

items.core: a per-sample TF-gene network
items.prompt: We have RNA-seq from 64 prostate tumors plus motif and protein interaction data. We want each tumor's own TF-gene network rather than one averaged network.

items.core: a TF/miRNA-gene network for the cohort
items.prompt: We have expression from 110 colon samples, motif and protein interaction priors, and miRNA target predictions. We want one network where both TFs and miRNAs regulate genes.

items.core: communities of regulators and genes
items.prompt: We already built a TF-gene network for heart tissue. We want to break it into modules of regulators and target genes that are densely connected to each other.

items.core: two-layer partial-correlation network with edge p-values
items.prompt: We have matched miRNA and mRNA expression from 95 tumors. We want direct associations between the two layers after conditioning on everything else, with significance for each edge.

items.core: per-sample co-expression networks
items.prompt: We only have gene expression from 48 patients and no regulator priors. We want a gene co-expression network for each patient that we can compare across patients.

items.core: co-expression attributable to a covariate
items.prompt: We want to know how much of the gene-gene co-expression in our 160 samples is explained by age, while adjusting for sex, using a design matrix.

items.core: patient subtypes from mutations
items.prompt: We have somatic mutation data for 350 ovarian tumors. We want to group the patients into subtypes based on which pathways are mutated.

items.core: per-sample networks related to a clinical variable
items.prompt: With expression, motif and protein interaction priors for 120 asthma patients, we want each patient's regulatory network and to relate TF targeting to their lung function scores.

items.core: per-sample two-layer networks
items.prompt: We have proteomics and transcriptomics from the same 70 patients. We want a protein-transcript partial-correlation network for each individual patient.
